title: gRPC and Protocol Buffers
description: Conventions for gRPC and Protocol Buffers.

rules.title: Never reuse field numbers
rules.text: Never change or reuse a field number; mark removed fields and names as reserved.

rules.title: Additive changes only
rules.text: Evolve messages additively; renaming, retyping or removing fields breaks existing clients.

rules.title: Deadlines on every call
rules.text: Set a deadline on every client call and propagate it to downstream calls.

rules.title: Use canonical status codes
rules.text: Return the canonical gRPC status codes with a useful message instead of encoding errors in successful responses.

rules.title: Lint and detect breaking changes
rules.text: Run buf lint and buf breaking in CI.

rules.title: Encrypt transport
rules.text: Use TLS (or mTLS between services) for every gRPC channel outside localhost.
